notes.title: Death Becomes You: Yuri Onsen Vacation releasing on Steam!
notes.content:
Hello! Thank you so much for supporting Death Becomes You. We’re excited to announce that we're releasing a side story on November 7, 2024!

[i]Death Becomes You: Yuri Onsen Vacation[/i] follows Alice and Sophie after graduation. As a couple, they finally get time off to go on a vacation together! However, their trip gets inturrupted by mysterious magic. The last straw: "MY FOOD!!!" Will the couple be able to find the culprit and finally enjoy their vacation?

The Steam version has the following features:

[list]
[*] Free to play
[*] Kinetic visual novel (no choices)
[*] ~8,000 word story
[*] Original sprite art, and 2 CGs (cutscenes)
[*] Extras gallery
[*] Exclusive developer Q&A
[*] Steam achievements
[*] (Optional) Preview mode voice acting
[*] Original game jam version launch option
[/list]

You can wishlist the Steam page [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3187380/Death_Becomes_You_Yuri_Onsen_Vacation/]here[/url], or follow our social media: [url=https://linktr.ee/quillyuri]Linktree[/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3187380/Death_Becomes_You_Yuri_Onsen_Vacation/

notes.content:

Good luck. Our ghosts have prepared their takeout containers, all plastic, non-microwaveable.[/quote]

notes.title: Death Becomes You, coming to consoles on August 4th!
notes.content:
3 exciting pieces of news here at Quill Yuri to share with you!

[h2]Death Becomes You console release[/h2]

[b]Death Becomes You[/b], murder mystery set in a magical school, is coming to consoles on August 4th.
[list]
[*] Nintendo Switch
[*] Playstation 5, Playstation 4
[*] Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One
[/list]
You can find all the download links on this page: [url=https://www.quill-studios.com/death-becomes-you/#download]Link[/url]

If you know any friends who would enjoy this game, please let them know! And of course, we hope you will consider getting a copy on your platform of choice (Steam included!) Your support has helped us continue to bring yuri games to you.

[h2]Lachesis or Atropos Steam release (free title)[/h2]

We've recently brought developer [b]4noki's[/b] horror mystery yuri visual novel, [b]Lachesis or Atropos[/b], to Steam. Please do check it out if you find it interesting!

We're also currently sitting close to 10 reviews on Steam, and getting to 10 will help us [url=https://howtomarketagame.com/2022/01/25/why-your-first-10-reviews-are-the-most-important/]boost[/url] our visibility on Steam a lot!

Download here for free:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2234770/Lachesis_or_Atropos/

[h2]New game sneak peeks on Patreon[/h2]

Due to the major shifts in social media (we're talking the former bird app), we decided it's best to post some more mid-length updates elsewhere. We're pleased to bring you our first devlog on Patreon for free! We'll have a good amount of free posts, as we wish to bring more yuri to the world and share it.

Read our first update for free here!
https://www.patreon.com/posts/quill-yuri-dev-1-86769507

notes.title: UPDATE: July 18th release date for Lachesis or Atropos

Quill Yuri is excited to announce we're publishing 4noki's horror mystery yuri visual novel, Lachesis or Atropos, on Steam.

A private investigator visits a small town after recovering from a coma. She searches for her mentor's lost beloved, but the very eyes she was born with, those that can see the black strings of hate, drag her down into the darkness of conspiracy.

Out on July 18th, 2023. Wishlist on Steam now!

notes.title: Steam Achievements update + troubleshooting guide
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Death Becomes You! We've updated the game with a patch that should resolve an issue of Steam achievements not unlocking. (Mostly occurring with folks who had previous builds.) Here's how to troubleshoot!

1. In your Steam library, right click "Death Becomes You" and select "Properties" > "LOCAL FILES" > "Verify integrity of game files...". This should allow the update to be run!
2. Restart your game, and Steam achievements should pop up.

If this doesn't work, below are some more steps you may need. Note the the below might affect your save files, so you might need to skip through again to where you left off.

Alternative 1. On Windows, check your persistent files. This is located in %[b]AppData%/RenPy/Death-Becomes-You[/b] or [b][User]/AppData/Roaming/RenPy/Death-Becomes-You[/b]. There may be a file named persistent - delete it.

Alternative 2. In your Steam library, right click "Death Becomes You" and select "Manage" > "Browse local files". Then, navigate to the /game/saves folder, and delete the persistent files (and saves, potentially).

Alternative 3. Uninstall the game and re-install it, if the earlier step of verifying game files didn't work.

If you are still encountering issues, please comment on this announcement or guide, and we'll be sure to help you out. Thank you again for the patience, and hope you enjoy the story!
